drop_zero_prefix.note: Presented as dropping a redundant assign() since leading zeroes 'encode to nothing'; leading zero bytes no longer produce '1' digits, so every address with a zero version byte (P2PKH mainnet) encodes wrongly.

long_input_no_trailing_ws.note: Adds a 'fast path' for long inputs (over 120 characters) that skips the trailing-whitespace scan; long strings with trailing whitespace are now rejected instead of accepted. Upstream and property tests only pad short strings with whitespace.

full_sweep.note: Presented as removing a data-dependent branch from the inner loop so it vectorises; it now sweeps the whole digit buffer for every input byte instead of only the digits used so far, which is more work.
